title: Miami Weekend Guide: Oct. 3 and 4
igCaption:
Tonight has Kany García at Kaseya Center, Chucho Valdés at the Adrienne Arsht Center, Electric Feels at ZeyZey, and Karol G at Hard Rock Stadium.
Sunday has Don Omar at Kaseya Center and Mariachi El Bronx at Revolution Live.
Which one would you try to make this weekend?

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #ThingsToDoMiami #MiamiWeekend #SouthFloridaEvents

scenes.text: Need plans tonight or Sunday? Miami has concerts, a DJ party, and late-night Brightline trains after scheduled Kaseya Center concerts.

Tonight, Kany García plays Kaseya Center. Sunday, Don Omar plays the same arena. Brightline runs late-night trains from MiamiCentral after scheduled concerts, and the station sits less than a mile away.
scenes.caption: Tonight, Kany García plays Kaseya Center. Sunday, Don Omar plays the same arena. Brightline runs late-night trains from MiamiCentral after scheduled concerts, and the station sits less than a mile away.

scenes.text: At eight tonight, Chucho Valdés celebrates his eighty-fifth birthday at the Adrienne Arsht Center. He has seven Grammys and seven Latin Grammys. Joe Lovano and Terence Blanchard join him. Tickets run fifty-two to one hundred fifty-eight dollars.
scenes.caption: At 8 tonight, Chucho Valdés celebrates his 85th birthday at the Adrienne Arsht Center. He has 7 Grammys and 7 Latin Grammys. Joe Lovano and Terence Blanchard join him. Tickets run $52 to $158.

scenes.text: Electric Feels starts at nine tonight at ZeyZey on Northeast Sixty-First Street. The Los Angeles-based party brings a rotating lineup of DJs and a stage production. Tickets cost eighteen dollars.
scenes.caption: Electric Feels starts at 9 tonight at ZeyZey on NE 61st St. The Los Angeles-based party brings a rotating lineup of DJs and a stage production. Tickets cost $18.

scenes.text: Sunday at seven, Mariachi El Bronx plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. The band is on its You Ese Tour after a ten-year hiatus, with Bedouin Soundclash and Max Diaz. Tickets cost thirty-eight dollars and fifty cents.
scenes.caption: Sunday at 7, Mariachi El Bronx plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. The band is on its You Ese Tour after a 10-year hiatus, with Bedouin Soundclash and Max Diaz. Tickets cost $38.50.

scenes.text: Which one are you picking, tonight or Sunday? Weekends here are mostly deciding where to be, while NEAR quietly shows the other side of that choice: the people who were there too.
